definitions.explanation: A standard-sized bottle holding 720 milliliters (four go), most commonly used for sake, shochu, and other Japanese alcoholic beverages. One of the two standard bottle sizes in the Japanese alcohol industry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{四合瓶|よんごうびん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a 720ml bottle of sake.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四合瓶|よんごうびん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ちょうどいい→ちょうどいい：21521_choudoii⟧⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧だ。
examples.english: A 720ml bottle is just the right size for a souvenir.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{蔵元|くらもと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{限定品|げんていひん}→限定品：16189_genteihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四合瓶|よんごうびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しか⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This brewery's limited edition is only sold in 720ml bottles.

notes:
Composed of {四合|よんごう} (four go, a traditional unit of volume) and ⟦{瓶|びん}→瓶：01016_bin⟧ (bottle). One ⟦{合|ごう}→合：27628_gou⟧ is approximately 180ml, so four go equals 720ml. This is one of the two standard sake bottle sizes in Japan, the other being the ⟦{一升瓶|いっしょうびん}→一升瓶：08958_isshoubin⟧ (1.8L bottle, or ten go). The {四合瓶|よんごうびん} is the more portable size and is popular for gifts and home consumption.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四合瓶|よんごうびん}⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧: one 720ml bottle
- {四合瓶|よんごうびん}⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧: 720ml bottle size
- {四合瓶|よんごうびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧: to order by the 720ml bottle

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{一升瓶|いっしょうびん}→一升瓶：08958_isshoubin⟧: 1.8-liter bottle — the larger standard size, roughly equivalent to a wine magnum
- ⟦{合|ごう}→合：27628_gou⟧: a traditional Japanese unit of volume (approximately 180ml), also used for measuring rice
